fusions.name: Thrashed Dust
fusions.desc: Beats out a cone of dust 2 tiles long, dealing 4 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fulling Stocks
fusions.desc: Pounds the target for 13 damage, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it 18% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Colours to the Mast
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more Power while it holds.

fusions.name: Arming Doublet
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you have 10% blunt resistance.
